design_rule: Boss and mini-boss recruitment is not a canonical NG+ rule. Creature recruitment remains restricted to explicitly eligible ordinary creatures. Human/person antagonists, justice subjects, historical figures and bosses are not converted into capturable companions by changing cycle.
migration_note: The previous catalog is intentionally retired because it conflated creature capture with arrest, justice, personhood and boss progression. Any future exceptional recruit must be approved individually in canon and use a relationship appropriate to that entity rather than inheriting the generic CAPTURER verb.
